name: Seance
author: Erin Carter
description: A full-frame veil of near-black weave from behind which vague rounded forms press forward — brightening, stretching the cloth's highlights, and gathering a faint palette halo before relaxing back into the dark. Almost a face, almost a hand, then gone.

params.label: Emerge speed
params.effect: Speed of the press-through and dissolve cycle; low makes each visitation a half-minute swell, high an uneasy steady churn.

params.label: Form size
params.effect: Characteristic diameter of the pressing swellings in CSS pixels, from fist-sized knots to frame-dominating presences.

params.label: Presence
params.effect: Peak contrast and brightness a form reaches before dissolving — how close to legibility the apparitions come.

params.label: Striations
params.effect: Amount of concentric-ring and radial-ray detail woven through each emanation; 0 leaves a soft blob, 1 a finely-striated spirit halo.
